def process_spell(spell):
    lines = spell.strip().split('\n')
    result = []
    is_amplifying = False

    for line in lines:
        if line.strip() == '#':
            is_amplifying = True
            result.append(line)
        elif '#' in line:
            is_amplifying = True
            line = line.split('#')[0].rstrip() + '#' + line.split('#')[1].lstrip()
            result.append(line)
        else:
            if is_amplifying:
                result[-1] += line.replace(' ', '')
            else:
                result.append(line.replace(' ', ''))
            is_amplifying = False

    return '\n'.join(result) + '\n'
